II. Usage Tutorial#

Note: The following commands are taken directly from the README. Where the README does not specify exact command lines, I will mark them; please refer to TUTORIAL.md or the original documentation of each tool as the standard.

Step 1: Environment Preparation#

Required Environment:

  • Python 3.10+, recommended to use the conda environment named AI
  • Node.js 18+, only required for the ../ai-companion/ repository
  • Local Inference Engine: Default is Ollama, which is used for both conversation and translation via gemma4:26b. Alternatives are vLLM on Linux and transformers on Windows, which use tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B and will be automatically downloaded upon first run
  • External Programs installed on demand:
    • website requires Hugo, pngquant, and HandBrakeCLI
    • Data synchronization requires rclone
conda activate AI

Step 2: Installation#

Execute in the repository root directory:

# common 包 + summarize / research / benchmark / website 的依赖
pip install -e ".[all]"

# translator 不包含在 all 里，需要单独安装
pip install -e ".[translator]"

# 只需要 website 时（包含翻译用的 torch 和 transformers）
pip install -e ".[website]"

After installation, build/ and gadget.egg-info/ will be generated in the repository root. They are already gitignored; do not commit them. For specific dependencies of each tool, see requirements.txt in their respective directories.

Optional: Install ai-companion. Only install if development workflows and skills are needed.

  • Checkout git@github.com:TzJ2006/ai-companion.git to the sibling directory ../ai-companion/
  • For installation methods, see ../ai-companion/scripts/install.ts

Step 3: Configuration#

1. Configuration Files

  • Manually copy config.example.json from the repository root to config.json. This file is gitignored.
  • If other paths are needed, specify them using the environment variable GADGET_CONFIG.
  • Purpose of each section:
    • sync section: Configuration for sync.py
    • summarize section: Persistent parameters for local LLM

2. Keys

API keys and onboarding forms are located in the tokens/ directory. This directory is gitignored, absolutely do not commit it.

3. Selecting LLM Backend

All features involving LLM can switch backends using --api, or set globally via the environment variable GADGET_LLM_BACKEND.

Backend Description
ollama Default. Local Ollama, no key required, uses Gemma4-26B
claude_cli Reuses the login status of Claude Code CLI, no API key required
anthropic Anthropic API
openai OpenAI API

Global setting example:

export GADGET_LLM_BACKEND=claude_cli

4. Translation-related Environment Variables

  • GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND: Values can be ollama (default), llamacpp, vllm or transformers
  • GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL: Overrides the default translation model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B

5. Optional: Generate Ollama variants optimized for summarize and export environment variables

eval "$(bash scripts/serve_local_llm.sh env)"

6. One-click Configuration for New Machines

First, fill in tokens/onboard.yaml, then run scripts/onboard.py once. It will automatically complete:

  • SSH configuration
  • Claude/Codex CLI installation and authentication
  • pip extras and ai-companion installation
  • Configuration for each tool
  • rclone bootstrap

The README only mentions “run the script once” without providing the full command line arguments.

If using an Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 server, system-level installation is required. Please use the scripts in the ai-companion repository and check the help first:

bash ../ai-companion/scripts/onboard-server.sh --help

7. Verifying Installation

The smoke test is read-only: it only checks if --help, --info and various modules can be imported; it does not call LLM, connect to the internet, or write files.

bash scripts/smoke.sh

Step 4: Usage of Each Tool#

4.1 Summarize: AI Conversation Daily / Weekly / Monthly Reports#

The workflow is divided into two stages:

  1. Export conversation logs on each device
  2. Synchronize logs to one place via cloud drive or manual copy, then merge them daily to generate daily reports

Once enough daily reports have accumulated, weekly and monthly reports can be generated.

# 阶段 1：导出所有尚未导出的日期
python -m summarize daily export

# 阶段 2：同步所有日期并逐日合并
python -m summarize daily merge --sync-all

# 生成指定周的周报并部署
python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W12 --deploy

# 生成指定月的月报并部署
python -m summarize monthly generate --month 2026-02 --deploy

# 一键跑完整流程：导出 → 合并 → 周报 → 月报 + 部署
python -m summarize auto --deploy
  • Token usage and costs are automatically tracked by ccusage 20.x, which categorizes commands by source: ccusage claude, ccusage codex, ccusage gemini, etc.
  • Old entries python tools/summarize/daily_summary.py, weekly_summary.py, monthly_summary.py are still available, but using python -m summarize is recommended.
  • For detailed instructions, see tools/summarize/tutorial.md.

4.2 Research: Paper Discovery and Researcher Analysis#

# 完整流程：搜索 → 三阶段评估 → 报告
python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project

# 自然语言搜索，自动路由到合适的数据源
python tools/research/research_scout.py ask "找 Pieter Abbeel 最近的机器人操作论文"

# 研究者画像
python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine"

# 引用图谱，参数可以是 arXiv ID 或 DOI
python tools/research/research_scout.py citations 2301.12597

# 把报告部署到 Hugo
python tools/research/research_scout.py deploy
  • Deep paper insights are enabled via --insight. The README does not specify which subcommand it is attached to.
  • Both conference paper search and author search are supported, but the README does not provide specific commands.
  • Please refer to tools/research/TUTORIAL.md for the above two items.

4.3 Benchmark: Performance Benchmarking#

All commands must be executed after entering the tools/benchmark/ directory:

cd tools/benchmark

# 运行全部测试，结果追加写入 CSV
python -m benchmark.cli

# 只测 CPU
python -m benchmark.cli --cpu-only

# 只测 GPU
python -m benchmark.cli --gpu-only

# 运行测试并生成 HTML 报告
python -m benchmark.cli --report

# 生成报告并发布到 Hugo 的 /benchmark/
python -m benchmark.cli --report --deploy
  • GPU will be automatically detected (CUDA, MPS, or XPU).
  • OpenCL will only appear in the detection results of --info and cannot actually run tests.
  • CSV uses append mode and never overwrites, so results run on different machines will naturally accumulate into a leaderboard.

4.4 Website: Hugo Blog#

# 安装依赖
pip install -e ".[website]"

# macOS/Linux：增量压缩 + Hugo 构建 + 推送到 Pages
cd tools/website && bash update.sh

# Windows：脚本会自动 cd 到自己所在的目录
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/website/update.ps1

# 本地预览，启动开发服务器，包含草稿
cd tools/website && hugo server -D

Notes:

  • Content generated by each tool will be written directly to tools/website/content and tools/website/static, marked with gadget_generated. Hand-written files without this mark will not be overwritten.
  • Compression only processes media files that have changed since .last_build.
  • tools/website/public/ is an independent deployment repository (tzj2006/tzj2006.github.io), which is automatically committed and pushed by build scripts. Do not commit to it manually.
  • The translation model will be automatically downloaded upon the first run.

4.5 Translator: Gradio Document Translator#

# 安装 gradio 和 GGUF 翻译栈
pip install -e ".[translator]"

# 启动 GUI，会在浏览器中打开
python -m translator

Backend Selection: The translator will automatically select the inference backend.

  • If the corresponding model tag has been pulled, ollama is prioritized.
  • On Linux, vllm is prioritized.
  • On Windows, it falls back to transformers.
  • When VRAM is limited, llamacpp (GGUF format) can be selected.

Models:

  • The default model is tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B, and the GGUF version is tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF, which will be automatically downloaded upon first use.
  • You can switch models using GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL or the model management in the GUI.
  • Models remain in memory after loading; they are loaded on demand when switching models.

Languages:

  • When the source language is set to auto, the language is determined by the proportion of CJK characters in the text.
  • When the target language is set to auto, it performs mutual translation between Chinese and English.

4.6 Cross-device Data Synchronization```bash#

python scripts/sync.py # 运行同步脚本 python scripts/sync.py push # 推送 python scripts/sync.py pull # 拉取


- Supported operations: push, pull, status, bootstrap, config.
- Synchronized data categories: summarize, website, research, benchmark, backups. There is also a special category `dag` used for generating and deploying DAG sites.
- Before use, rclone must be configured; synchronization settings are written in the `sync` section of `config.json`.

---

## Step 5: Where is the output

All artifacts are under `outputs/`. This directory is gitignored and can be deleted and rebuilt at any time.

```text
outputs/
├── logs/      # 中间产物（导出日志、运行日志）
├── reports/   # 最终报告（Markdown、JSON、HTML）
├── cache/     # LLM 缓存、搜索缓存
├── data/      # 结构化数据（CSV、JSON 画像）
├── images/    # 图表和生成的图片
└── backups/   # 强制覆盖前的备份

Hugo site content is an exception: it is written directly to tools/website/content and tools/website/static.

Common Notes#

  • Do not git add the following content:
    • Automatically generated content
    • Data synchronized via rclone
    • build/ and gadget.egg-info/
    • Deployment repositories and theme repositories under tools/website/
    • The tokens/ directory
  • For step-by-step operations, data formats, and FAQ for each tool, please refer to TUTORIAL.md in the root directory. The Chinese version of the README is in docs/README.zh.md.
  • The project uses the GPL-3 license.
Fable 5.1 (effort high) — 8,091 chars · 16/16 facts

The following is completed based on the README content: first a project summary, then a usage tutorial for beginners. All commands and parameters are taken solely from the README.

I. Project Summary#

What this is. gadget is a collection of practical tools accumulated by the author during daily development, covering five directions: AI conversation daily report generation, paper discovery and researcher analysis, CPU/GPU performance benchmarking, Hugo blog automation, and document translation. Each tool is located in an independent directory under tools/ and can be used separately. Common capabilities (LLM calls, JSON parsing fixes, disk caching, atomic writes, local translation engine, Hugo deployment) are unified in the common/ package in the repository root, installed via pip install -e .. The development workflow engine and all Claude Code skills are not in this repository, but in a sibling independent repository ai-companion, accessed through hooks under .claude/ and .codex/. The project uses the GPL-3 license.

Repository Structure.

Directory / File Role
tools/summarize/ AI conversation daily / weekly / monthly reports
tools/research/ Paper discovery + researcher analysis + citation graphs
tools/benchmark/ CPU/GPU performance benchmarking
tools/website/ Hugo blog (incremental media compression + automatic build & publish)
tools/translator/ Gradio document translator
common/ Shared infrastructure package relied upon by all tools
scripts/ Maintenance scripts: sync.py, onboard.py, smoke.sh, serve_local_llm.sh, language.py, profile_translation.py
docs/ Design documents, ECL plan (docs/ecl/), audit reports, historical archives (docs/archive/)
outputs/ All generated artifacts (gitignored, can be rebuilt automatically), subdivided into logs / reports / cache / data / images / backups
tokens/ API keys and onboarding forms, gitignored, must NEVER be committed
AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md AI agent working protocols and Claude Code repository guide
pyproject.toml Packaging configuration
config.json Tool settings (gitignored, copy from config.example.json), paths can be overridden via GADGET_CONFIG

What each tool does.

  • Summarize: Reads conversation logs from Claude Code / Codex / Cursor Agent / ChatGPT / general JSON, and calls LLMs to generate structured daily, weekly, and monthly reports. It uses a multi-device two-stage architecture: each device first exports logs, which are then aggregated via cloud drive synchronization or manual copying before being merged to generate the report. Through the source-specific commands of ccusage 20.x (ccusage claude, ccusage codex, ccusage gemini), it automatically calculates token usage and costs for each agent CLI.
  • Research: A unified entry point tools/research/research_scout.py providing four types of capabilities. Paper discovery: searches arXiv / bioRxiv / PubMed, and uses a three-stage LLM pipeline (“fast screening → deep evaluation → citation impact”) to generate research weekly reports and deploy them to Hugo, supporting conference paper and author searches. Deep Insight (--insight): downloads full texts to analyze writing structures and publication strategies, automatically matching OpenReview reviews. Researcher Profiling: combines arXiv + Semantic Scholar data to generate research trajectory analysis and tier scores, automatically discovering mentor-student relationships, and supporting name disambiguation and reverse lookup. Citation Graph: performs forward citation / backward reference analysis based on the Semantic Scholar API.
  • Benchmark: Cross-platform CPU/GPU FLOPS testing, supporting NVIDIA CUDA, Apple MPS, Intel XPU (OpenCL only appears in --info detection), covering FP64 / FP32 / FP16 / BF16 / FP8 (experimental). It uses a Warm-up + Formal Measurement + Statistical Analysis (median, IQR for outlier removal) approach, with explicit GPU synchronization to ensure timing accuracy. Results are written to CSV in append mode, and can generate Plotly interactive HTML reports and leaderboards, supporting deployment to Hugo and submission to public leaderboards.
  • Website: The Hugo static blog “TzJ’s Net” (PaperMod theme), deployed to GitHub Pages. It features built-in incremental media compression (only processes files changed after .last_build, using pngquant for images and HandBrakeCLI for video) and local model Chinese-English bilingual translation (defaults to Ollama; Linux falls back to vLLM, Windows falls back to transformers; the model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B is automatically downloaded on first run). Automatically generated content is written directly to tools/website/content|static with gadget_generated tags; handwritten files will not be overwritten. tools/website/public/ is an independent deployment repository, automatically committed and pushed by build scripts; do not commit directly to it.
  • Translator: A Gradio web translator based on the common translation engine, providing a local interface similar to Google Translate. It supports text and .md / .txt / .pdf / .docx / image files, protecting Markdown snippets like code blocks, URLs, and Hugo shortcodes during translation. The entire process is local inference, with the backend (ollama / transformers / vllm / llamacpp) automatically selected via common.engine.create_engine(). Models remain in memory, with lazy loading on demand when switching models. The source language can be set to auto (detected by CJK ratio), and the target auto flips between Chinese and English.

Four LLM Backends. All LLM functions are switched via --api: ollama (default, local Ollama, no key required, Qwen3.8-27B), claude_cli (reuses Claude Code CLI login state, no API key required), anthropic, and openai. Global settings can also be configured via the GADGET_LLM_BACKEND environment variable.

II. Usage Tutorial#

1. Environment Preparation

  • Python 3.10 or above, recommended to use a conda environment AI.
  • Node.js 18 or above, only required for the ../ai-companion/ independent repository.
  • For specific dependencies of each tool, see requirements.txt in their respective directories.
  • Website construction requires Hugo, pngquant, and HandBrakeCLI.
  • Cross-device synchronization requires configuring rclone.
  • The default LLM backend is local Ollama; if you do not want to install Ollama, you can use --api claude_cli to reuse the Claude Code login state, or use anthropic / openai and place API keys in the tokens/ directory.
conda activate AI

2. Installation

Execute in the repository root. all includes the common package and dependencies for the four tools: summarize / research / benchmark / website, but does not include translator, which must be installed separately.

pip install -e ".[all]"
pip install -e ".[translator]"

If you only need a single tool, you can also install just the base package or a single extra:

pip install -e .
pip install -e ".[website]"

Installation will generate build/ and gadget.egg-info/ in the repository root; these are gitignored and should not be committed.

3. Configuration

  • Copy config.example.json to config.json and modify as needed. config.json is gitignored. When you need to change paths, set the GADGET_CONFIG environment variable.
  • sync.py reads the sync section of config.json; persistent settings for serve_local_llm.sh are placed in the summarize section.
  • API keys are placed in the tokens/ directory and must NEVER be committed.
  • Global environment variables: GADGET_LLM_BACKEND sets the LLM backend; GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND sets the translation engine (ollama → llamacpp / vllm / transformers); GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL overrides the translation model.For one-time configuration of a new machine, you can follow the onboarding process: fill in tokens/onboard.yaml, and run scripts/onboard.py once; the script will automatically complete SSH configuration, Claude/Codex CLI installation and authentication, pip extras and ai-companion installation, tool configurations, and rclone bootstrap.
python scripts/onboard.py

After installation, you can run a read-only smoke test to check if all tools’ --help / --info / import are working normally, without triggering LLM, network, or write operations:

bash scripts/smoke.sh

4. Summarize: Daily / Weekly / Monthly Reports

The typical workflow is divided into two stages. First, export unexported dates on each device, then sync and merge them day by day on the aggregation device. Once enough daily reports have accumulated, weekly and monthly reports are generated, and --deploy will be deployed to Hugo simultaneously.

python -m summarize daily export
python -m summarize daily merge --sync-all
python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W12 --deploy
python -m summarize monthly generate --month 2026-02 --deploy
python -m summarize auto --deploy

auto is a one-click full process: Export → Merge → Weekly Report → Monthly Report + Deployment. To switch the LLM backend, add --api, for example --api claude_cli. Old entry points python tools/summarize/daily_summary.py ..., weekly_summary.py, and monthly_summary.py are still available, but the new format is recommended.

If you want to create a specifically fine-tuned local Ollama variant for summarize and export environment variables:

eval "$(bash scripts/serve_local_llm.sh env)"

5. Research: Paper Discovery and Researcher Analysis

The unified entry point is tools/research/research_scout.py, run in the repository root directory.

python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project
python tools/research/research_scout.py ask "找 Pieter Abbeel 最近的机器人操作论文"
python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine"
python tools/research/research_scout.py citations 2301.12597
python tools/research/research_scout.py deploy
  • report --project: Full pipeline, Search → Three-stage evaluation → Report generation.
  • ask: Natural language search, automatically routes data sources.
  • profile: Researcher profiling.
  • citations: Citation graph based on arXiv ID or DOI.
  • deploy: Deploy reports to Hugo.
  • For deep paper insights, add the --insight parameter. All LLM features support backend switching via --api.

6. Benchmark: Performance Benchmarking

All commands must first enter the tools/benchmark/ directory. Results are appended to a CSV and will not overwrite old results; multiple runs on multiple hardware will naturally accumulate into a leaderboard.

cd tools/benchmark
python -m benchmark.cli
python -m benchmark.cli --cpu-only
python -m benchmark.cli --gpu-only
python -m benchmark.cli --report
python -m benchmark.cli --report --deploy
  • Without parameters: Run all tests.
  • --cpu-only / --gpu-only: Test only CPU or GPU.
  • --report : Run tests and generate an HTML report.
  • --report --deploy : Generate reports and publish to the /benchmark/ page on Hugo.
  • --info : Detect hardware information. GPU will automatically identify CUDA / Apple MPS / Intel XPU.

7. Website: Hugo Blog

First, install website extra (which includes torch + transformers required for translation), then run the build script. The script performs incremental compression, translation, and Hugo building, and automatically commits and pushes to the tools/website/public/ deployment repository.

pip install -e ".[website]"
cd tools/website && bash update.sh

For Windows, use the PowerShell script; the script will switch to its own directory automatically:

powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/website/update.ps1

Local preview (development server, including drafts):

cd tools/website && hugo server -D

Notes: The first run will automatically download the translation model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B. Hand-written articles should be placed directly in tools/website/content; files without the gadget_generated tag will not be automatically overwritten. Do not commit directly to tools/website/public/, and do not git add the deployment repository or the theme repository.

8. Translator: Document Translator

pip install -e ".[translator]"
python -m translator

After starting, a Gradio interface will open in your browser, allowing you to translate text or upload .md / .txt / .pdf / .docx / images. The default model is tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B (GGUF variant tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF), which will be automatically downloaded upon first use. To change models, set GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL or operate within the model management in the interface. Backend selection rules: if a model tag is already pulled, ollama is prioritized; on Windows, it falls back to transformers; on Linux, vllm is prioritized; if VRAM is insufficient, llamacpp is used to load GGUF.

9. Cross-device Data Synchronization

sync.py uses rclone to centrally synchronize data categories such as summarize / website / research / benchmark / backups, supporting push / pull / status / bootstrap / config operations. There is also a special dag category used for generating and deploying DAG sites.

python scripts/sync.py
python scripts/sync.py push
python scripts/sync.py pull

10. Other Scripts and ai-companion

  • scripts/language.py : Hugo bilingual audit and summarize report renaming.
  • scripts/profile_translation.py : Translation engine GPU performance analysis.
  • ai-companion is an independent Node.js repository that needs to be cloned to ../ai-companion/. It provides code change tracking, a /idea → /ccplan → /ccedit planning and execution pipeline, and all skills. See ../ai-companion/scripts/install.ts for installation instructions.
  • A system-level one-click installation script for Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 servers is also in that repository:
bash ../ai-companion/scripts/onboard-server.sh --help

In it, --companion-repo directly passes the ai-companion repository address git@github.com:TzJ2006/ai-companion.git, and --companion-ref is no longer required.

11. Output Locations and Submission Norms

All generated products are under outputs/: logs/ intermediate products, reports/ final reports, cache/ LLM and search cache, data/ structured data, images/ charts, and backups/ forced overwrite backups. Hugo content is written directly to tools/website/content|static, with no separate staging directory. Never git add automatically generated content, rclone synchronized data, build/, gadget.egg-info/, or any files under tokens/.

If you need to publish this tutorial as a shareable webpage, just let me know.

I. Project Summary#

What it is#

Gadgets is a collection of practical tools accumulated during daily development, covering AI daily report generation, paper discovery, performance benchmarking, blog automation, and document translation. Each directory under tools/ is an independently usable tool; shared infrastructure is unified in the common/ package located in the repository root (installed via pip install -e .), providing common capabilities such as LLM invocation, JSON parsing, disk caching, atomic writes, translation, and Hugo deployment.

The development workflow (planning/execution/change tracking) and all Claude Code skills are provided by ai-companion — an independent repository (git@github.com:TzJ2006/ai-companion.git), checked out in the sibling directory ../ai-companion/, and integrated into this repository via hooks. The license is GPL-3.

Repository Structure#

gadget/
├── tools/              # 五个独立工具产品(改工具来这里)
│   ├── summarize/      # AI 对话日报 / 周报 / 月报
│   ├── research/       # 论文发现 + 研究者分析 + 引用图谱
│   ├── benchmark/      # CPU/GPU 性能基准测试
│   ├── website/        # Hugo 博客(增量媒体压缩 + 自动构建发布)
│   └── translator/     # Gradio 文档翻译器
├── common/             # 共享基础设施包(LLM / 缓存 / IO / 翻译 / Hugo)—— 所有工具依赖它
├── scripts/            # 运维 + 维护脚本(sync.py, onboard.py, language.py, profile_translation.py, …)
├── docs/               # 设计文档、ECL 计划(docs/ecl/)、审计报告、历史归档(docs/archive/)
├── outputs/            # 所有生成产物(gitignored,可自动重建)
├── AGENTS.md           # 所有 AI agent 的工作流协议(行动前先读)
├── CLAUDE.md           # 给 Claude Code 的仓库指南
└── pyproject.toml      # common/ 与各工具的打包配置(pip install -e .)

build/ and gadget.egg-info/ are generated by pip install -e . (already gitignored, always located in the repository root).

Where to go to change things:

Goal Where to go
Change logic of a specific tool tools/<tool>/
Change shared capabilities (LLM / Cache / Translation / Hugo deployment) common/
Change data synchronization scripts/sync.py
One-time configuration of a new machine scripts/onboard.py
Change development workflow / skill ai-companion repository (sibling ../ai-companion/)
Read plans / design documents docs/ecl/, docs/

What each tool does#

tools/summarize/ —— AI Chat Daily/Weekly/Monthly Reports#

Automatically reads daily AI chat logs (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor Agent / ChatGPT / general JSON), calls LLM APIs to generate structured daily, weekly, and monthly reports. Multi-device workflow: each device exports chat logs → sync via cloud drive or manual copy to aggregation → generate final daily reports; once enough daily reports accumulate, weekly and monthly trend summaries are generated. Automatically discovers and statistics token usage and costs for all agent CLIs via the namespace-by-source command in ccusage 20.x (ccusage claude, ccusage codex, ccusage gemini…). Four types of AI summary backends, unified via --api switching. Key technologies: Claude/OpenAI API, ccusage 20.x (multi-source unification), matplotlib.

tools/research/ —— Paper Discovery and Researcher Analysis#

A unified academic research toolbox providing four major capabilities through a single CLI entry point tools/research/research_scout.py:

  • Paper Discovery: Search for papers from arXiv / bioRxiv / PubMed, following a three-stage LLM pipeline (fast screening → deep evaluation → citation influence), generating research weekly reports and deploying them to Hugo. Supports conference paper search and author search.
  • Deep Paper Insights (--insight): Download full paper texts, letting the LLM analyze their writing structure, publication strategies, and reusable core knowledge; automatically matches OpenReview to obtain peer review comments, analyzing consensus and controversy; synthesizes cross-paper research writing guides.
  • Researcher Profiling: Scrape paper and citation data from ArXiv + Semantic Scholar, with LLM generating research trajectory analysis, calculating tier scores, and automatically discovering mentor-student relationships through homepage extraction + co-authorship patterns. Supports name disambiguation and reverse lookup.
  • Citation Graph Analysis: Forward citation / backward reference analysis based on Semantic Scholar API, combined with LLM-driven influence interpretation.

tools/benchmark/ —— Performance Benchmarking SuiteCross-platform CPU/GPU FLOPS benchmarking tool, providing unified floating-point performance measurement across different hardware vendors and precision levels. Supports actual GPU execution for NVIDIA(CUDA), Apple Silicon(MPS), and Intel(XPU) (OpenCL may only appear in --info detection), covering precisions such as FP64 / FP32 / FP16 / BF16 / FP8(experimental). Measurement employs warm-up + formal measurement + statistical analysis (median, IQR outlier removal), and explicit GPU synchronization to ensure timing accuracy. Results are accumulated in CSV in append mode (never overwritten, naturally supporting multi-hardware cumulative leaderboards), and can generate interactive HTML reports and leaderboards with Plotly charts, supporting deployment to Hugo websites and submission to public leaderboards.#

tools/website/ —— Hugo Blog#

Hugo static blog site (“TzJ’s Net”, PaperMod theme), deployed to GitHub Pages (https://tzj2006.github.io/). Features a built-in incremental image/video compression pipeline (only compresses media changed since .last_build: images via pngquant, videos via HandBrakeCLI) and local model bilingual translation (defaulting to Ollama, with vLLM on Linux / transformers on Windows as fallbacks; model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B is automatically downloaded upon first run, without using cloud LLM APIs). Automatically generated content (daily/weekly/monthly reports, research reports, benchmark pages, images) is written directly to tools/website/content|static by the deployment pipeline (the sole Hugo content root, files are marked with gadget_generated; handwritten files without marks are never overwritten), then translated, compressed, built, and pushed.

⚠️ tools/website/public/ is a standalone deployment repository (tzj2006/tzj2006.github.io), which is automatically committed + pushed by build scripts —— do not commit directly to it.

tools/translator/ —— Gradio Document Translator#

A Gradio document translator based on the common translation engine: a local translation web interface in the style of Google Translate, translating text and files (.md / .txt / .pdf / .docx / images) while preserving Markdown formatting (code blocks, URLs, Hugo shortcodes, etc., are protected). It runs local inference instead of cloud APIs: reuses common.engine.create_engine() to automatically select the backend (if the model tag is already pulled, ollama is prioritized; transformers is the Windows fallback, vllm is prioritized on Linux, and llamacpp is the low-VRAM GGUF option), with models staying in memory (warm) and being lazily loaded on demand when switching models. Default model is tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B (GGUF variant tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF), automatically downloaded upon first use, which can be overridden via GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL or the model management within the GUI. Source language can be set to auto (detected by CJK text ratio); when the target language is auto, it flips between zh↔en.

common/ —— Shared Infrastructure Package#

The shared layer upon which all tools depend, installed as a Python package via pip install -e .:

  • LLM calls (unified two-layer API, supporting four backends: ollama(default) / claude_cli / anthropic / openai))
  • JSON parsing and repair
  • SHA-256 disk cache (namespace + TTL)
  • Atomic writes and content hashing
  • Local inference translation engine (Ollama / vLLM / transformers / GGUF) and bilingual content generation
  • Cross-platform Hugo deployment

scripts/ —— DevOps and Maintenance Scripts#

  • sync.py —— Centralized rclone data synchronization (push / pull / status / bootstrap / config, covering summarize / website / research / benchmark / backups categories; there is also a special dag category for generating + deploying DAG sites). Configured via the sync section of the repository root config.json (paths can be overridden using GADGET_CONFIG).
  • onboard.py —— Repository-level one-time machine initialization: fill out a YAML table (tokens/onboard.yaml), run the script once, and it automatically completes SSH configuration, Claude/Codex CLI installation and authentication, pip extras and ai-companion installation, tool configurations, and rclone bootstrap.
  • smoke.sh —— Read-only smoke checks covering all tools (--help / --info / import; does not involve LLM, network, or writing).
  • serve_local_llm.sh —— Creates an Ollama variant optimized for summarize and prints environment variables. Persistence switches are located in the summarize section of the repository root config.json.
  • Others: language.py (Hugo bilingual audit + summarize report renaming), profile_translation.py (translation engine GPU profiler).

../ai-companion/ —— Independent Repository#

An independent Node.js repository, checked out in the peer directory ../ai-companion/, not within this repository. It records function-level code changes, generates tests and HTML reports, provides a /idea→/ccplan→/ccedit planning-execution pipeline, and hosts all Claude Code skills (methodologies + domains). This repository connects via hooks under .claude/ and .codex/.

It is packaged both as a standard Claude Code plugin and an equivalent Codex integration —— ready to use upon installation without building (the change tracking hook is a pre-built single-file product committed with the repository). All skills (Methodologies: ccplan planning, optimize optimization, cchypothesis debugging, repo-audit auditing, repo-tidy tidying; Domains: summarize code overview, slurm-gpu cluster detection, nature-benchmark / NIPS-2025-paper paper writing advisor) are located in that repository; this repository no longer contains the skills/ directory. For installation, see ../ai-companion/scripts/install.ts.

outputs/ —— Output Directory#

All generated outputs are unified in outputs/ (already gitignored, can be automatically rebuilt):

outputs/
├── logs/         # 中间产物(导出日志、运行日志)
├── reports/      # 最终报告(Markdown、JSON、HTML)
├── cache/        # LLM 缓存、搜索缓存
├── data/         # 结构化数据(CSV、JSON profiles)
├── images/       # 图表和生成的图片
└── backups/      # 强制覆盖备份(website-force 等)

Hugo site content is written directly to tools/website/content|static (there is no independent outputs/site staging tree).

II. Usage Tutorial (For First-Timers)#

This tutorial only covers what is mentioned in the README. For step-by-step operations, configuration, data formats, and FAQs for each tool, please further consult the TUTORIAL.md in the repository and each tool’s own source documentation.

Step 0: Environment Preparation#

  • Python 3.10+ (conda environment AI is recommended)
  • Node.js 18+ (only required for the independent repository ../ai-companion/)
  • For specific dependencies of each tool, see the requirements.txt in their respective directories
  • website / translation functions use a local inference engine (default Ollama; vLLM on Linux, transformers on Windows as fallbacks), with model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B automatically downloaded upon first run

Activate the recommended environment:

conda activate AI

Step 1: Installation#

Install the common package + extras for summarize / research / benchmark / website:

pip install -e ".[all]"

⚠️ Note: all does not include translator, which must be installed separately:

pip install -e ".[translator]"

If you only want to use a specific tool, you can also install just the corresponding extra:

pip install -e ".[website]"      # website(含 torch + transformers 用于翻译)
pip install -e ".[translator]"   # translator(gradio + GGUF 翻译栈)

After installation, build/ and gadget.egg-info/ will be generated in the repository root (already gitignored, which is normal).

Step 2: Configuration#

Tool Configuration Files: config.json at the repository root (already gitignored), obtained by copying from config.example.json:

cp config.example.json config.json

To use different paths, set environment variables to override:

export GADGET_CONFIG=/path/to/your/config.json

Among them, the sync section is for scripts/sync.py configuration, and the summarize section is for the scripts/serve_local_llm.sh persistence switch.

API Keys: Placed in the tokens/ directory (already gitignored, never commit its contents).

LLM Backend Selection: All LLM functions use the --api parameter for switching, with four possible values:

Value Description
ollama Default, local Ollama, no key required, Qwen3.8-27B
claude_cli Reuses the login status of Claude Code CLI, no API key needed
anthropic Anthropic API
openai OpenAI API

You can also set it globally using environment variables:

export GADGET_LLM_BACKEND=ollama

Translation Backend: Translation uses the local inference engine, selected by GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND: ollama (default when the model is already pulled, uses local Ollama server) → llamacpp / vllm / transformers (in-process), with model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B. The translation model can be overridden:

export GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND=ollama
export GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL=tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B

Step 3 (Optional): One-time Initialization for New Machines#

After filling out the tokens/onboard.yaml YAML table, run:

python scripts/onboard.py

It will automatically complete SSH configuration, Claude/Codex CLI installation and authentication, pip extras and ai-companion installation, tool configurations, and rclone bootstrap.

Server System-level Installation (Ubuntu 22.04/24.04, one-click installation of SSH public keys, Claude Code, Codex, Superpowers, Ponytail, and AI Companion) has been migrated to the ai-companion repository:```bash bash ../ai-companion/scripts/onboard-server.sh –help


After the repository split, `--companion-repo` is directly passed to the ai-companion repository (`git@github.com:TzJ2006/ai-companion.git`), and `--companion-ref` is no longer needed.

## Step 4: Run a smoke test first

Read-only, no LLM/network/writing, used to confirm installation:

```bash
bash scripts/smoke.sh

Tool 1: Summarize —— AI Chat Daily/Weekly/Monthly Reports#

The python -m summarize format is recommended. The typical workflow is two-stage: export on each device first, then aggregate and merge.

python -m summarize daily export                                   # 阶段 1:导出所有尚未导出的日期
python -m summarize daily merge --sync-all                         # 阶段 2:同步所有日期并逐日合并
python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W12 --deploy       # 周报 + 部署
python -m summarize monthly generate --month 2026-02 --deploy      # 月报 + 部署
python -m summarize auto --deploy                                  # 一键全流程:导出 → 合并 → 周报 → 月报 + 部署

Multi-device usage: Run daily export on each device, aggregate the logs together via cloud drive synchronization or manual copying, then run daily merge --sync-all to generate the final daily report; once enough daily reports have accumulated, generate weekly and monthly trend summaries.

Switching AI summary backend:

python -m summarize auto --deploy --api claude_cli

If you want to use the summarize tuning variant from local Ollama:

eval "$(bash scripts/serve_local_llm.sh env)"

Old entries python tools/summarize/daily_summary.py ... / weekly_summary.py / monthly_summary.py are still available (backward-compatible re-export shim), but the new format above is recommended.

See TUTORIAL.md#summarize and tools/summarize/tutorial.md for details.

Tool 2: Research —— Paper Discovery and Researcher Analysis#

Single CLI entry tools/research/research_scout.py:

python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project        # 全流程:搜索 → 三阶段评估 → 报告
python tools/research/research_scout.py ask "找 Pieter Abbeel 最近的机器人操作论文"  # 自然语言搜索(自动路由数据源)
python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine"             # 研究者画像
python tools/research/research_scout.py citations 2301.12597               # 引用图谱(按 arXiv ID / DOI)
python tools/research/research_scout.py deploy                              # 把报告部署到 Hugo

Use --insight for deep insights; all LLM functions support switching backends via --api, for example:

python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project --api claude_cli

See TUTORIAL.md#research and tools/research/TUTORIAL.md for details.

Tool 3: Benchmark —— Performance Benchmarking#

⚠️ All commands require first cd into tools/benchmark/.

cd tools/benchmark
python -m benchmark.cli                    # 跑全部基准测试(结果追加到 CSV)
python -m benchmark.cli --cpu-only         # 只跑 CPU
python -m benchmark.cli --gpu-only         # 只跑 GPU
python -m benchmark.cli --report           # 跑测试 + 生成 HTML 报告
python -m benchmark.cli --report --deploy  # 生成报告 + 发布到 Hugo /benchmark/

To only view hardware detection results without actually running, use --info (note that OpenCL may only appear in --info detection and does not mean it can actually run). GPU benchmarks will automatically detect CUDA / Apple MPS / Intel XPU. Results are accumulated in append mode and will not overwrite history, so you can run them on multiple machines and accumulate them into a leaderboard.

See TUTORIAL.md#benchmark and tools/benchmark/tutorial.md for details.

Tool 4: Website —— Hugo Blog#

pip install -e ".[website]"                          # 安装依赖(含 torch + transformers 用于翻译)
cd tools/website && bash update.sh                   # macOS/Linux:增量压缩 + Hugo 构建 + 推送 Pages
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/website/update.ps1  # Windows(脚本会自己 cd 到所在目录)
cd tools/website && hugo server -D                   # 本地预览(dev server,包含草稿)

Bilingual auditing and summarize report renaming:

python scripts/language.py

Two red lines that must be remembered:

  1. tools/website/public/ is an independent deployment repository, which is automatically committed and pushed by build scripts —— do not commit directly into it.
  2. Automatically generated files carry the gadget_generated tag; handwritten files without the tag will never be overwritten —— so handwritten content is safe, but do not add that tag to handwritten files.

See TUTORIAL.md#website and tools/website/CLAUDE.md for details.

Tool 5: Translator —— Gradio Document Translator#

pip install -e ".[translator]"   # 安装依赖(gradio + GGUF 翻译栈)
python -m translator             # 启动 Gradio GUI(在浏览器中打开)

After starting, you can translate text in the web page, or upload .md / .txt / .pdf / .docx / image files. Selecting auto as the source language will automatically detect based on text CJK ratio; selecting auto as the target language will flip between Chinese and English. You can change models via model management within the GUI, or set environment variables before starting:

export GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL=tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF
python -m translator

The model will be automatically downloaded upon first use, with full local inference, without using cloud APIs.

For UI wiring see tools/translator/app.py, for translation and file logic see tools/translator/core.py, and for the shared engine see common/engine.py and common/translation.py. See TUTORIAL.md#translator for details.

Cross-device Data Synchronization#

python scripts/sync.py           # 查看用法
python scripts/sync.py push      # 推送
python scripts/sync.py pull      # 拉取

Subcommands include push / pull / status / bootstrap / config, covering categories summarize / website / research / benchmark / backups, with a special dag category used for generating + deploying DAG sites. You need to configure rclone first; the configuration is in the sync section of config.json.

Common Precautions (Must Obey)#

  • tokens/ stores API keys and onboarding forms, which are gitignored —— never commit contents from here.
  • All generated file outputs go to outputs/, which is gitignored.
  • Never git add: automatically generated content, rclone synchronized data, build artifacts (build/, gadget.egg-info/), and the deployment and theme repositories under tools/website/.
  • Read AGENTS.md (workflow protocols for all AI agents) before taking action.
  • This project is licensed under GPL-3 (see LICENSE).

What Each Tool Does#

Tool Function Key Technologies
summarize Reads daily AI chat records (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor Agent / ChatGPT / general JSON), calls LLM to generate structured daily/weekly/monthly reports; uses ccusage 20.x to statistics token usage and costs for each Agent CLI Claude/OpenAI API, ccusage 20.x, matplotlib
research Provides paper discovery (arXiv/bioRxiv/PubMed three-stage LLM pipeline), deep paper interpretation (--insight, including OpenReview reviewer matching), researcher profiling (including mentor-student relationship mining), and citation graph analysis via a unified CLI (research_scout.py) arXiv/bioRxiv/PubMed, Semantic Scholar, LLM
benchmark Cross-platform CPU/GPU FLOPS evaluation, supporting NVIDIA/Apple Silicon/Intel, multiple precisions (FP64~FP8), results accumulated as CSV, can generate HTML reports and deploy to Hugo PyTorch, NumPy, Plotly
website Hugo static blog (PaperMod theme), built-in incremental image/video compression (pngquant/HandBrakeCLI) and local model bilingual translation, automatic content writing to `tools/website/content static`
translator Gradio web translator based on the common translation engine, supporting text and files (.md/.txt/.pdf/.docx/images), preserving Markdown format, with local inference Gradio, GGUF/transformers

All LLM functions switch backends uniformly through --api: ollama (default, local, no key required), claude_cli (reuses Claude Code login state), anthropic, openai.

# Gadget Project Complete Guide

## 1. Project Summary

### 1.1 Project Overview

**Gadget** is a collection of open-source tools that brings together practical utilities accumulated during daily development. It covers the following functions:
- **AI Daily Report Generation** — Automatically statistics AI conversation records from multiple devices to generate daily/weekly/monthly reports.
- **Paper Discovery** — Searches and evaluates papers from academic databases, analyzing researchers and citation networks.
- **Performance Benchmarking** — Cross-platform FLOPS testing for CPU/GPU.
- **Blog Automation** — Hugo static site, supporting incremental media compression and automatic deployment.
- **Document Translation** — A Gradio translator with local inference, supporting text and various file formats.

### 1.2 Repository Structure

gadget/ ├── tools/ # 5个独立工具产品 │ ├── summarize/ # AI对话日/周/月报告 │ ├── research/ # 论文发现 + 研究者分析 + 引文图 │ ├── benchmark/ # CPU/GPU性能基准测试 │ ├── website/ # Hugo博客（增量压缩 + 自动发布） │ └── translator/ # Gradio文档翻译器 ├── common/ # 共享基础设施包（所有工具依赖） ├── scripts/ # 运维脚本（数据同步、机器配置等） ├── docs/ # 设计文档和ECL计划 ├── outputs/ # 生成的文件（自动重建，已gitignore） ├── CLAUDE.md # Claude Code 仓库指南 └── pyproject.toml # Python打包配置


### 1.3 Functions of Each Tool

| Tool | Function | Core Features |
|------|------|---------|
| **Summarize** | AI conversation daily/weekly/monthly reports | Multi-device aggregation, multi-source token statistics, switchable between 4 LLM backends |
| **Research** | Paper discovery + researcher analysis | arXiv/bioRxiv/PubMed search, three-stage evaluation, citation graphs, research trajectory analysis |
| **Benchmark** | CPU/GPU performance testing | Supports CUDA/MPS/XPU, multiple precisions (FP64-FP8), HTML reports + Plotly charts |
| **Website** | Hugo blog | Incremental image/video compression, automatic publishing to GitHub Pages, local bilingual translation |
| **Translator** | Document translator | Local inference, supports MD/TXT/PDF/DOCX/images, preserves formatting |

### 1.4 Infrastructure

- **common/** — Shared capabilities such as LLM calls, disk cache, translation engine, Hugo deployment, etc.
- **scripts/** — Data synchronization (`sync.py`), machine initialization (`onboard.py`), LLM services (`serve_local_llm.sh`), etc.
- **ai-companion/** — A separate Node.js repository (located in `../ai-companion/`), providing code change tracking and all Claude Code skills.

---

## 2. Detailed Usage Tutorial

### 2.1 Environment Preparation

#### System Requirements

- **Python 3.10+** (conda environment recommended)
- **Node.js 18+** (only required for the `ai-companion` repository)
- Git

#### Creating Python Environment

```bash
# 使用conda创建Python 3.10环境
conda create -n AI python=3.10
conda activate AI

# 或者使用venv
python3.10 -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate  # Linux/macOS
# 或在Windows上: venv\Scripts\activate

2.2 Installation Steps#

Step 1: Clone the Repository#

git clone <gadget-repository-url>
cd gadget

Step 2: Install Common Packages and All Tools#

# 安装common包 + summarize/research/benchmark/website的所有依赖
pip install -e ".[all]"

# 如果需要translator工具，需单独安装
pip install -e ".[translator]"

# 如果需要website工具的完整功能（包含torch+transformers用于翻译）
pip install -e ".[website]"

Step 3: Prepare API Keys and Configuration#

# 创建token目录（存放API密钥等敏感信息，已gitignore）
mkdir -p tokens/

# 从示例配置创建主配置文件
cp config.example.json config.json

# 编辑config.json，填入以下信息：
# - LLM API密钥（如果使用anthropic或openai后端）
# - Hugo部署配置（如果使用website工具）
# - rclone数据同步配置（如果需要跨设备数据同步）

Step 4: One-time Machine Initialization (Optional but Recommended)#

If it is a new machine, you can use the automation script to complete all configurations at once:

# 编辑初始化配置表
# 打开 tokens/onboard.yaml，填入SSH/API密钥/工具配置等

# 运行初始化脚本
python scripts/onboard.py

# 这个脚本会自动完成：
# - SSH配置
# - Claude Code / Codex CLI 登录
# - pip 依赖安装
# - 各工具配置
# - rclone 引导启动

Step 5: Verify Installation#

# 运行烟雾测试（只读，无LLM调用，无网络，无写入）
bash scripts/smoke.sh

2.3 Tool Configuration#

Global LLM Backend Configuration#

All tools switch backends via the unified --api parameter:

# 方式1：命令行指定
python -m summarize daily export --api ollama

# 方式2：环境变量全局设置
export GADGET_LLM_BACKEND=claude_cli
python -m summarize daily export  # 自动使用claude_cli

# 可用后端
# - ollama（默认，本地Ollama，无需密钥，模型：Qwen3.8-27B）
# - claude_cli（重用Claude Code CLI登录状态，无需API密钥）
# - anthropic（需要ANTHROPIC_API_KEY环境变量）
# - openai（需要OPENAI_API_KEY环境变量）

Translation Engine Configuration#

The translation used by the Website and Translator tools utilizes local inference:

# 方式1：自动选择（推荐）
# - Ollama已安装且模型已拉取 → 使用ollama
# - Linux → vllm优先
# - Windows → transformers优先

# 方式2：指定后端
export GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND=transformers

# 方式3：指定模型
export GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL=tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF

# 默认模型会在首次使用时自动下载

Ollama Local LLM Service (Recommended)#

# 启动Ollama服务并输出环境变量
eval "$(bash scripts/serve_local_llm.sh env)"

# 这会：
# 1. 拉取并启动 Qwen 模型（如果未启动）
# 2. 输出环境变量供后续命令使用
# 3. 持久化配置保存在repo根目录 config.json 的 summarize 字段

2.4 Detailed Usage for Each Tool#

2.4.1 Summarize — AI Conversation Daily/Weekly/Monthly Reports#

Function: Automatically extracts token usage and conversation content from multi-device AI conversation records to generate structured daily, weekly, and monthly reports.

Workflow:

  1. Export unexported conversation records on each device (Phase 1)
  2. Aggregate via cloud drive synchronization or manual copying (Phase 2)
  3. Generate daily, weekly, and monthly reports

Typical Commands:

# === Phase 1: 导出所有未导出日期的对话记录 ===
python -m summarize daily export

# === Phase 2: 同步所有日期并逐日合并 ===
python -m summarize daily merge --sync-all

# === 生成周报（周号格式：2026-W12，表示2026年第12周）===
python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W12

# 生成周报并自动发布到Hugo博客
python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W12 --deploy

# === 生成月报（月份格式：2026-02）===
python -m summarize monthly generate --month 2026-02

# 生成月报并发布
python -m summarize monthly generate --month 2026-02 --deploy

# === 一键完整流程 ===
# 导出 → 合并 → 生成周报 → 生成月报 + 自动发布
python -m summarize auto --deploy

# === 指定LLM后端 ===
python -m summarize daily export --api anthropic
python -m summarize auto --deploy --api openai

Supported LLM Backends:

  • ollama (default, local, no key required)
  • claude_cli (reuses Claude Code CLI)
  • anthropic (requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)
  • openai (requires OPENAI_API_KEY)

Detailed Step-by-step Tutorial: See TUTORIAL.md — Summarize and tools/summarize/tutorial.md

2.4.2 Research — Paper Discovery and Researcher Analysis#

Function: A unified academic research toolkit providing paper discovery, deep paper analysis, researcher analysis, and citation graph analysis.

Entry Point: tools/research/research_scout.py

Typical Commands:

# === 论文发现完整流程 ===
# 搜索论文 → 三阶段评估（快速筛选→深度评估→引文影响）→ 生成周报 → 发布Hugo
python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project

# === 自然语言搜索（自动路由源）===
python tools/research/research_scout.py ask "找 Pieter Abbeel 最近的机器人操作论文"

# === 研究者分析 ===
# 获取论文+引用数据，生成研究轨迹分析，计算分级分数

python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine"

# === 引文图分析 ===
# 基于Semantic Scholar API的前向/后向引用分析
python tools/research/research_scout.py citations 2301.12597

# === 发布报告到Hugo ===
python tools/research/research_scout.py deploy

# === 指定LLM后端 ===
python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project --api claude_cli
python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine" --api anthropic

LLM Backend Options:

  • ollama (default)

Supported Hardware:

This is a Chinese explanation organized solely based on the README you pasted; no commands or parameters not mentioned in the README have been added.

I. Project Summary#

Gadgets is a collection of practical tools accumulated during daily development, covering five areas: AI conversation daily report generation, paper discovery, performance benchmarking, blog automation, and document translation.

Each directory under tools/ is an independent tool that can be used separately. The common/ in the repository root is the shared infrastructure, installed via pip install -e ., providing LLM calls, JSON parsing, disk caching, atomic writes, translation, and Hugo deployment. The development workflow (planning / execution / change tracking) and all Claude Code skills are not in this repository, but in the independent repository ai-companion (git@github.com:TzJ2006/ai-companion.git), checked out to the sibling directory ../ai-companion/, and connected to this repository via hooks.

This README is an overview. Step-by-step operations, configurations, data formats, and FAQs for each tool can be found in TUTORIAL.md as well as the source code documentation of each tool. The Chinese version of the README is at docs/README.zh.md.

Repository Structure#

gadget/
├── tools/              # 五个独立工具（改某个工具就进这里）
│   ├── summarize/      # AI 对话日 / 周 / 月报
│   ├── research/       # 论文发现 + 研究者分析 + 引用图
│   ├── benchmark/      # CPU/GPU 性能基准
│   ├── website/        # Hugo 博客（增量媒体压缩 + 自动构建发布）
│   └── translator/     # Gradio 文档翻译
├── common/             # 共享包（LLM / 缓存 / IO / 翻译 / Hugo），所有工具都依赖它
├── scripts/            # 运维与维护脚本
├── docs/               # 设计文档、ECL 计划（docs/ecl/）、审计报告、历史归档（docs/archive/）
├── outputs/            # 全部生成物（已 gitignore，可自动重建）
├── AGENTS.md           # 所有 AI agent 的工作流协议（动手前先读）
├── CLAUDE.md           # Claude Code 的仓库指南
└── pyproject.toml      # common/ 与各工具的打包配置（pip install -e .）

build/ and gadget.egg-info/ are generated by pip install -e ., are gitignored, and are always in the repository root. Data synchronization uses python scripts/sync.py.

What do you want to change Where to go
Logic of a specific tool tools/<tool>/
Shared capabilities (LLM / cache / translation / Hugo deployment) common/
Data synchronization scripts/sync.py
One-time configuration for a new machine scripts/onboard.py
Development workflow / skill ai-companion (sibling directory ../ai-companion/ )
Plan / Design documents docs/ecl/, docs/

What Each Tool Does#

Directory Role Key Technologies
tools/summarize/ AI conversation daily / weekly / monthly summaries (multi-device two-stage architecture) Claude/OpenAI API, ccusage 20.x, matplotlib
tools/research/ Paper discovery + researcher analysis + citation graphs arXiv/bioRxiv/PubMed, Semantic Scholar, LLM
tools/benchmark/ Cross-platform CPU/GPU performance benchmarks PyTorch, NumPy, Plotly
tools/website/ Hugo blog (incremental media compression + automatic build & publish) Hugo, pngquant, HandBrakeCLI
tools/translator/ Gradio document translation based on common translation engine Gradio, GGUF/transformers
common/ Shared infrastructure pip install -e .
scripts/ Operations scripts (rclone sync, machine configuration, etc.) rclone, Python
../ai-companion/ AI code change tracking + planning/execution skill pipeline + all skills Node.js, TypeScript

Summarize: Reads daily AI conversation logs (Claude Code / Codex / Cursor Agent / ChatGPT / general JSON), calls LLMs to generate structured daily, weekly, and monthly summaries. The multi-device workflow is: each device exports conversation logs, which are aggregated via cloud drive sync or manual copying, then the final daily report is generated; once enough daily reports are collected, weekly and monthly trends can be generated. Through ccusage 20.x source-based commands (ccusage claude, ccusage codex, ccusage gemini…), it automatically discovers and statistics the token usage and costs of various agent CLIs. The four AI summary backends are switched uniformly via --api: ollama (default, local Ollama, no key required, Gemma4-26B), claude_cli (reuses Claude Code CLI login state, no API key required), anthropic, and openai.

Research: A single entry point tools/research/research_scout.py with four capabilities:

  • Paper Discovery: Searches arXiv / bioRxiv / PubMed using a three-stage LLM pipeline (fast screening → deep evaluation → citation impact), generating research weekly reports and deploying them to Hugo. Supports conference paper search and author search.
  • Deep Paper Insights (--insight): Downloads full texts, analyzes writing structure, publication strategies, and reusable core knowledge; automatically matches OpenReview to obtain reviewer comments and analyze consensus and divergence; synthesizes these into research writing guides across papers.
  • Researcher Profiling: Takes paper and citation data from ArXiv + Semantic Scholar to generate research trajectory analysis and calculate hierarchical scores; automatically discovers mentor–student relationships through homepage extraction + co-authorship patterns. Supports name disambiguation and reverse lookup.
  • Citation Graphs: Performs forward citation / backward reference analysis based on the Semantic Scholar API, supplemented by LLM impact interpretation.

LLMs are also switched via --api: ollama (default), claude_cli, anthropic, and openai.

Benchmark: Cross-platform CPU/GPU FLOPS benchmarks, measuring floating-point performance uniformly across different hardware vendors and precision levels. Actual GPU execution supports NVIDIA (CUDA), Apple Silicon (MPS), and Intel (XPU); OpenCL may only appear in --info detection. Precision includes FP64 / FP32 / FP16 / BF16 / FP8 (experimental). The measurement process consists of warmup + formal measurement + statistical analysis (median, IQR outlier removal), and explicitly performs GPU synchronization to ensure timing accuracy. Results are appended to CSV files (not overwritten, allowing natural accumulation of multi-hardware leaderboards), can generate interactive HTML reports and leaderboards with Plotly charts, and supports deployment to Hugo websites or submission to public leaderboards. All commands must first run cd tools/benchmark.

Website: Hugo static blog (“TzJ’s Net”, PaperMod theme), deployed to GitHub Pages (https://tzj2006.github.io/). Built-in incremental image/video compression: only compresses media that has changed since .last_build (images via pngquant, videos via HandBrakeCLI). Bilingual translation uses local models (default Ollama; falls back to vLLM on Linux, and transformers on Windows; model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B is automatically downloaded on first run, without using cloud LLM APIs). Automatically generated content (daily/weekly/monthly reports, research reports, benchmark pages, images) is written directly by the deployment pipeline into tools/website/content|static (the unique Hugo content root; files marked with gadget_generated will be written, while un-marked handwritten files will not be overwritten), then translated, compressed, built, and pushed. tools/website/public/ is another deployment repository (tzj2006/tzj2006.github.io), which is automatically committed and pushed by build scripts; do not commit directly to it.Translator: A Gradio page based on the common translation engine, styled similarly to Google Translate. It translates text and files ( .md / .txt / .pdf / .docx / images) while preserving Markdown format (fragments like code blocks, URLs, Hugo shortcodes, etc., are protected). It performs local inference, not cloud API. Automatically selects the backend via common.engine.create_engine(): prioritizes ollama when model tags have been pulled; falls back to transformers on Windows, prioritizes vllm on Linux, and offers llamacpp (GGUF) for low VRAM. Models are kept in memory (warm), with lazy loading applied when switching models. The default model is tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B (GGUF variant tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF), which is automatically downloaded upon first use; it can be overridden using GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL or via the model management interface. The source language can be set to auto (detected by CJK text ratio); when the target is auto, it performs bidirectional translation between Chinese and English.

common/: The shared layer that all tools depend on.

  • LLM calls (unified two-layer API, four backends: ollama default / claude_cli / anthropic / openai)
  • JSON parsing and repair
  • SHA-256 disk caching (namespace + TTL)
  • Atomic writes and content hashing
  • Local inference translation engine (Ollama / vLLM / transformers / GGUF) and bilingual content generation
  • Cross-platform Hugo deployment

scripts/:

  • sync.py: Centralized rclone data synchronization (push / pull / status / bootstrap / config), covering summarize / website / research / benchmark / backups; includes a special category dag for generating and deploying DAG sites. Configuration is located in the sync section of the repository root config.json (paths can be overridden via GADGET_CONFIG).
  • onboard.py: One-time machine onboarding at the repository level. Fill out a YAML file ( tokens/onboard.yaml )), run the script once, and it will automatically complete SSH, Claude/Codex CLI installation and authentication, pip extras and ai-companion installation, tool configurations, and rclone bootstrap.
  • smoke.sh: Read-only smoke test ( --help / --info / imports; does not call LLMs, does not connect to the internet, does not write files).
  • serve_local_llm.sh: Creates an Ollama variant optimized for summarize and prints environment variables. Persistent switches are written in the summarize section of the repository root config.json (paths can be overridden via GADGET_CONFIG).
  • Others: language.py (Hugo bilingual audit + summarize report renaming), profile_translation.py (translation engine GPU analysis).

ai-companion: An independent Node.js repository, checked out at ../ai-companion/. It records function-level code changes, generates tests and HTML reports, provides a /idea → /ccplan → /ccedit planning–execution pipeline, and hosts all Claude Code skills. This repository connects via hooks under .claude/ and .codex/. It serves as both a standard Claude Code plugin and an equivalent Codex integration, ready to use upon installation without building (the change tracking hook is a pre-built single-file artifact submitted with the repository). Methodology skills: ccplan planning, optimize optimization, cchypothesis debugging, repo-audit auditing, repo-tidy tidying. Domain skills: summarize code overview, slurm-gpu cluster detection, nature-benchmark / NIPS-2025-paper paper writing advisor. This repository no longer contains the skills/ directory. For installation, see ../ai-companion/scripts/install.ts.

New Server Onboarding has two complementary paths: this repository uses scripts/onboard.py; system-level one-click installation for Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 (SSH public key, Claude Code, Codex, Superpowers, Ponytail, AI Companion) has moved to ai-companion: ../ai-companion/scripts/onboard-server.sh. After the repository split, --companion-repo is sent directly to the ai-companion repository ( git@github.com:TzJ2006/ai-companion.git ), and --companion-ref is no longer required. For usage, see bash ../ai-companion/scripts/onboard-server.sh --help.

Output Directory outputs/ (gitignored, can be automatically rebuilt):

outputs/
├── logs/         # 中间产物（导出日志、运行日志）
├── reports/      # 最终报告（Markdown、JSON、HTML）
├── cache/        # LLM 缓存、搜索缓存
├── data/         # 结构化数据（CSV、JSON 画像）
├── images/       # 图表和生成图片
└── backups/      # 强制覆盖备份（website-force 等）

Hugo site content is written directly to tools/website/content|static, without a separate outputs/site staging tree.

II. First-time Use Tutorial#

More detailed step-by-step operations, configurations, data formats, and FAQs can be found in TUTORIAL.md and the documentation of each tool. Below are only the steps and commands that appear in the README.

1. Environment Preparation#

  • Python 3.10+. Recommended conda environment AI: conda activate AI
  • Node.js 18+. Only the independent repository ../ai-companion/ requires it.
  • Specific dependencies for each tool can be found in the corresponding requirements.txt within their directories.
  • Website / translation functions default to local inference: Ollama, reusing the same chat model gemma4:26b during translation; falls back to vLLM on Linux and transformers on Windows; these two paths use tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B and are automatically downloaded upon first run.

2. Installation#

Install the common package, along with the extras for summarize / research / benchmark / website. all does not include the translator; the translator must be installed separately:

pip install -e ".[all]"
pip install -e ".[translator]"

If only installing the website (including torch + transformers for translation):

pip install -e ".[website]"

If only installing the translator (gradio + GGUF translation stack):

pip install -e ".[translator]"

pip install -e . will generate build/ and gadget.egg-info/ in the repository root, both of which are gitignored.

3. Configuration#

Tool settings are located in config.json at the repository root (gitignored). Copy a sample from:

# README 写的是：copy from config.example.json

That is, copy config.example.json to config.json in the repository root. Use the environment variable GADGET_CONFIG to change the configuration file path.

Environment variables related to configuration (mentioned in the README):

Variable Purpose
GADGET_CONFIG Overrides the path of config.json
GADGET_LLM_BACKEND Globally switches LLM backend
GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND Selects translation backend
GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL Overrides the translation model

LLM backends are switched uniformly via --api: ollama (default), claude_cli , anthropic , openai. You can also use GADGET_LLM_BACKEND for global settings.

The translation path is selected by GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND: ollama (default, local Ollama, reusing the already-served chat tag gemma4:26b ) → llamacpp / vllm / transformers (in-process, model tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B).

tokens/ stores API keys and access tables; it is gitignored, so do not commit its contents.

One-time machine onboarding: First fill out tokens/onboard.yaml, then run scripts/onboard.py (the README provides the script name and this workflow, but not the full command-line arguments). It will configure SSH, Claude/Codex authentication, pip extras, tool configurations, and rclone bootstrap.

System-level installation for Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 servers is in the sibling repository. Check the help first:

bash ../ai-companion/scripts/onboard-server.sh --help

After the repository split, --companion-repo is sent directly to git@github.com:TzJ2006/ai-companion.git and no longer requires --companion-ref. Installation instructions for ai-companion itself are in ../ai-companion/scripts/install.ts.

Cross-device data synchronization requires a configured rclone:

python scripts/sync.py
python scripts/sync.py push
python scripts/sync.py pull

The README also lists sub-capabilities of the same script: status , bootstrap , config. Configuration is in the sync section of config.json. The covered categories are summarize / website / research / benchmark / backups, with a special category dag (generating and deploying DAG sites).

Read-only smoke test (does not call LLMs, does not connect to the internet, does not write files):

bash scripts/smoke.sh

Prepare a local Ollama variant for summarize, and eval its printed environment variables into the current shell:

eval "$(bash scripts/serve_local_llm.sh env)"

Persistent switches are written in the summarize section of config.json.

4. Summarize: Daily / Weekly / Monthly Reports#

The recommended entry point is python -m summarize. Old entry points python tools/summarize/daily_summary.py ... , weekly_summary.py , monthly_summary.py are still available (backward-compatible re-exports), but the new format is recommended.

python -m summarize daily export                                   # 阶段 1：导出所有尚未导出的日期
python -m summarize daily merge --sync-all                         # 阶段 2：同步所有日期并按天合并
python -m summarize weekly generate --week 2026-W12 --deploy       # 周报并部署
python -m summarize monthly generate --month 2026-02 --deploy      # 月报并部署
python -m summarize auto --deploy                                  # 一键全流程：export → merge → weekly → monthly + deploy

Multi-device usage (workflow described in README): Export conversation logs on each device, sync them via cloud drive or manual copy for aggregation, then generate the final daily report; once enough daily reports are accumulated, generate weekly and monthly trends. Token usage is tracked via ccusage 20.x commands by source, such as ccusage claude , ccusage codex , ccusage gemini.Backend switching examples (the four values of --api are documented in the README; below, the default and the other three are appended to existing subcommands according to the documentation):

python -m summarize daily export --api ollama
python -m summarize daily export --api claude_cli
python -m summarize daily export --api anthropic
python -m summarize daily export --api openai

For step-by-step instructions, see the Summarize section of TUTORIAL.md and tools/summarize/tutorial.md.

5. Research: Papers and Researchers#

The entry point is tools/research/research_scout.py:

python tools/research/research_scout.py report --project my-project        # 全流程：搜索 → 三阶段评估 → 报告
python tools/research/research_scout.py ask "找 Pieter Abbeel 最近的机器人操作论文"  # 自然语言搜索（自动路由来源）
python tools/research/research_scout.py profile "Sergey Levine"             # 研究者画像
python tools/research/research_scout.py citations 2301.12597               # 引用图（arXiv ID 或 DOI）
python tools/research/research_scout.py deploy                              # 把报告部署到 Hugo

For deep insights, use --insight (the README explains the purpose of this switch: downloading full texts, analyzing writing and publication strategies, matching OpenReview, and synthesizing writing guides). The LLM backend is also --api: ollama, claude_cli, anthropic, openai.

For step-by-step instructions, see the Research section of TUTORIAL.md and tools/research/TUTORIAL.md.

6. Benchmark: Performance Benchmarks#

README note: All following commands must first enter tools/benchmark/.

cd tools/benchmark
python -m benchmark.cli                # 跑全部基准（结果追加到 CSV）
python -m benchmark.cli --cpu-only     # 只测 CPU
python -m benchmark.cli --gpu-only     # 只测 GPU
python -m benchmark.cli --report       # 跑基准并生成 HTML 报告
python -m benchmark.cli --report --deploy  # 生成报告并发布到 Hugo /benchmark/

GPU will automatically detect CUDA / Apple MPS / Intel XPU. OpenCL may only appear in the --info detection output (the README mentions this but does not provide a separate --info command-line example). Precision levels: FP64 / FP32 / FP16 / BF16 / FP8 (experimental). Results are appended to CSV, not overwriting history.

For step-by-step instructions, see the Benchmark section of TUTORIAL.md and tools/benchmark/tutorial.md.

7. Website: Hugo Blog#

pip install -e ".[website]"                          # 安装依赖（含翻译用的 torch + transformers）
cd tools/website && bash update.sh                   # macOS/Linux：增量压缩 + Hugo 构建 + 推送 Pages
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools/website/update.ps1  # Windows（脚本会 cd 到自己的目录）
cd tools/website && hugo server -D                   # 本地预览（开发服务器，包含草稿）

The site address is https://tzj2006.github.io/. Automatic content writing to tools/website/content and tools/website/static. Files marked with gadget_generated are generated files; handwritten files without this mark will not be overwritten. tools/website/public/ is the independent deployment repository tzj2006/tzj2006.github.io, which is committed and pushed by build scripts; do not git commit directly inside it.

For step-by-step instructions, see the Website section of TUTORIAL.md and tools/website/CLAUDE.md.

8. Translator: Document Translation Webpage#

pip install -e ".[translator]"   # 安装依赖（gradio + GGUF 翻译栈）
python -m translator             # 启动 Gradio 界面（在浏览器中打开）

Translatable text and files: .md, .txt, .pdf, .docx, and images. When the source language is set to auto, it detects based on CJK proportions; when the target is set to auto, it performs bidirectional translation between Chinese and English. Default model is tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B, with GGUF variant tencent/Hy-MT2-1.8B-GGUF; automatically downloaded on first use. To change models, use the environment variable GADGET_TRANSLATION_MODEL or perform model management in the interface.

The backend is automatically selected by common.engine.create_engine(): if the model tag is already pulled, ollama is prioritized; Windows falls back to transformers; Linux prioritizes vllm; low VRAM uses llamacpp. You can also specify using GADGET_TRANSLATION_BACKEND: ollama, llamacpp, vllm, transformers.

Interface wiring is in tools/translator/app.py, translation and file logic is in tools/translator/core.py, and the shared engine is in common/engine.py and common/translation.py. For step-by-step instructions, see the Translator section of TUTORIAL.md.

9. Where Outputs Are and What Not to Commit#

All generated items are in outputs/: logs/, reports/, cache/, data/, images/, backups/. This directory is already gitignored.

Do not git add these things:

  • Automatically generated content
  • Data synced via rclone
  • Build artifacts build/, gadget.egg-info/
  • Deployment and theme repositories under tools/website/
  • Keys and access tables in tokens/

The license is GPL-3, see LICENSE.

1. Project Summary#

What it is#

Gadgets is a collection of useful tools accumulated during daily development, covering five types of capabilities:

  • AI conversation daily / weekly / monthly report generation
  • Paper discovery and researcher analysis
  • Performance benchmarking
  • Blog automation
  • Document translation

Each directory under tools/ is an independently usable tool. Common capabilities are concentrated in the common/ package in the repository root (installed via pip install -e .), including LLM calls, JSON parsing, disk caching, atomic writing, translation, and Hugo deployment.

The development workflow (planning / execution / change tracking) and all Claude Code skills are not in this repository, but in the independent repository ai-companion (git@github.com:TzJ2006/ai-companion.git), which should be placed in the sibling directory ../ai-companion/ and accessed through the hooks of this repository.

This README is an overview; step-by-step operations, configuration, data formats, and FAQ can be found in TUTORIAL.md and the source documentation of each tool. The Chinese version of the README is at docs/README.zh.md.

Repository Structure#

gadget/
├── tools/              # 五个独立工具（改某个工具就进这里）
│   ├── summarize/      # AI 对话日/周/月报

Supplementary notes (original README text):

  • Workflow engine and skills are in ../ai-companion/, accessed via hooks under .claude/ and .codex/.
  • build/ and gadget.egg-info/ are generated by pip install -e ., are gitignored, and always reside in the repository root.
  • Synced data: python scripts/sync.py.
What do you want to change Where to go
Logic of a specific tool tools/<tool>/
